newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Elec issues convertibles in London.
newsitem.headline: LG Elec issues convertibles in London.

text.p: LG Electronics Inc, a unit of South Korea's LG Group, has issued $40 million worth of convertible bonds in London, co-lead manager LG Securities said on Wednesday.
The proceeds will be used to help finance the company's overseas investment, a statement from the brokerage house said.
The bond, with a 10-year maturity, would carry a 1.25 percent coupon, a 75 percent conversion premium and a yield to maturity of 133.20 percent.
Payment is due by November 26, and the bonds will be listed on the London Stock Exchange, the statement said.
Nomura Securities also acted as lead manager on the bond issue.
